sheet.$description: BottomSheet (and the ActionSheet on it): a panel that comes up from the bottom, with a handle, a title and its content.

inset.$description: Room between the panel and the edges of the room (0: on the bottom edge, as wide as it may be).

close-button.$description: The close button in the header.

list-box.$description: A list box inside a bottom sheet: the surface is its frame, so by default the list draws none of its own (no frame, fill or shadow).

scrim.$description: The scrim behind the panel (a modal sheet).

panel.$description: The panel; `full`: it reaches the top of the room (its top corners).

handle.$description: The handle along the top edge (a slider for the keys: `focus`).

grip.$description: The grip drawn in the handle.

header.$description: The header: the title and the buttons.

tools.$description: The header's buttons (the close button's look is its place's).

body.$description: The content (`focus`: it has the keys and scrolls by them, a ring inside it).

footer.$description: The footer: its buttons in a row.
